title: Is your mall also next to the ocean/beach?
content: Or any large body of water, really. My mall world is directly next to a beach + a large ocean. I once went for a nightswim until it was daytime and I had morphed into some sort of dolphin/alien looking creature, and then I found a paradise full of others like my in the middle of the ocean. We then grouped together and rode towards the mall on a huge wave, it kind of felt like we were going to war w/ the mall? Like we were liberating all the people there?
